one_sentence: Recent rain does not merely amplify an existing frog chorus: it reactivates previously silent, historically used species-by-site cells into overlapping/full chorus states and deepens their participation across multiple route stops, while the exact proximal cue remains unresolved.

conceptual_model.temporal_gate: Rainfall contrast predicts whether previously silent cells activate, including direct transitions to CallingIndex 2-3 and CallingIndex 3 full chorus.
conceptual_model.spatial_template: Where a route-new species reappears is strongly predicted by its own prior strong-chorus use of the same physical SiteID.
conceptual_model.ecological_interpretation: A persistent local acoustic template is intermittently expressed under wet conditions. This is compatible with recurrent local populations and stable breeding-site suitability, but does not prove continuous occupancy or individual site fidelity.
rejected_simplifications: simple attraction to stops where other species were already calling
a single NWI hydroperiod class or Palustrine-vs-Riverine/Lacustrine contrast

local_site_targeting.interpretation: Prior site use strongly predicts placement, but larger rain contrasts do not demonstrably sharpen that targeting.

opportunity_normalized_site_memory.interpretation: Rain selectively favors historically used same-SiteID cells beyond candidate-cell opportunity and route-level prior occurrence.

full_chorus_site_memory.note: Prior-only same-site CI3 component is individually imprecise, but total recurrent CI3 is supported and the no-prior component is null.

spatial_deepening.interpretation: The excess spatial footprint is concentrated at the third and later occupied stops and is almost entirely carried by species reaching CI2-3.

route_topology.interpretation: Route-order contiguity is excessive after conditioning on total extra-stop spread, but Euclidean MPD/MST compactness conditional on occupied-stop count is not supported.

geographic_heterogeneity.interpretation: The pooled effect is not driven by one state, but response magnitude and sign vary substantially among states.

mechanism_tests_not_supported.simple_social_cue_targeting: Route-new recruitment is not preferentially allocated to stops already acoustically active in the dry survey.
mechanism_tests_not_supported.acute_recency_gate: 0-1 day versus >=4 day strong-activation interaction is not supported.
mechanism_tests_not_supported.temperature_season_multicue_gate: Prespecified thermal and seasonal interaction families do not pass.
mechanism_tests_not_supported.nwi_hydroperiod_strong_chorus: Short-hydroperiod versus persistent-water interaction for CI2-3 is not supported at 200 m, 500 m, or same-observer sensitivity.
mechanism_tests_not_supported.nwi_wetland_system_strong_chorus: Palustrine versus Riverine/Lacustrine interaction is not supported.
mechanism_tests_not_supported.stable_general_stop_rain_slope: Empirical stop-level rainfall-response slopes are not temporally stable.
mechanism_tests_not_supported.euclidean_cluster: MPD/MST compactness beyond occupied-stop count is not established.

memory_age_diagnostic.reason: Only 136 routes had within-pair-species old-memory versus no-memory contrast; gate required >=200 routes.
memory_age_diagnostic.authorized_interpretation: Suggestive long-lived local template, but no formal PASS because the prefixed coverage gate failed.

external_generality.neotropical_anuraset: Two site tests do not pass the prefixed threshold-dominance replication rule.
external_generality.effort_complete_multisite_external_matri: No suitable public dataset identified in the current search.

established_background: rainfall and temperature influence anuran calling and breeding phenology
breeding-site and calling-station fidelity occur in some anuran species
interannual changes among breeding waterbodies occur
literature_position.apparent_contribution: Community-level rainfall expansion is routed through a persistent species-by-site acoustic template: weather provides the temporal gate, prior local chorus history predicts the spatial realization.

next_priority: Stop mechanism fishing here unless a new independent dataset or measured proximal hydrology becomes available. The present exploratory programme has identified a coherent recurrent-activation mechanism but not the physiological mediator.
